ko.executive_summary: Chinese foundries SMIC and Huahong Hongli reported Q2 results that exceeded expectations with positive forward guidance, signaling improved fab utilization and pricing environment for mature-node wafers. Citi's target-price raises reflect stronger BOM-cost stability and capacity recovery in the BCD/PMIC supply chain.
key_facts: SMIC (00981) and Huahong Hongli (01347) beat Q2 earnings expectations
Citi raised target prices and earnings forecasts for both foundries
Positive guidance provided for current quarter

implications.text: Q2 beat and positive forward guidance indicate rising capacity utilization at SMIC and Huahong, improving the supply-stability outlook for BCD-process PMIC orders.
Analyst target-price increases suggest pricing stabilization or modest recovery for mature-node foundry services, reducing downside risk for BOM costs in PMIC production.
Improved foundry visibility and guidance lift near-term PMIC supply reliability, particularly for Chinese-domestic and Asia-Pacific consumer and industrial applications.

ko.counterpoint: Headline lacks granularity on fab capacity additions, mix shift to automotive/server-grade PMIC, or unit-shipment data—analyst sentiment may not reflect structural demand recovery in high-reliability end-markets.
